scheme_name: US NRC 10 CFR 61.55 waste classification for near-surface disposal, Tables 1 and 2
scheme_version: eCFR current through title issue date 2026-10-13; section last amended 66 FR 55792, Nov. 2, 2001
rows_note: A row label is the first cell of the eCFR table row, character for character. Waste in the activated-metal form uses a nuclide's 'in activated metal' row where one exists, and the plain row otherwise; every other form uses plain rows only. Nb-94 and Ni-59 have an activated-metal row and no plain row.

table1.label: Alpha emitting transuranic nuclides with half-life greater than 5 years

table2.label: Total of all nuclides with less than 5 year half-life

table2_footnote: There are no limits established for these radionuclides in Class B or C wastes. Practical considerations such as the effects of external radiation and internal heat generation on transportation, handling, and disposal will limit the concentrations for these wastes. These wastes shall be Class B unless the concentrations of other nuclides in Table 2 determine the waste to be Class C independent of these nuclides.
